typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LOCATION as string,
		BASE_CURRENCY as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		ACC_BOOK_ID as integer,
		EOD_TIME as integer,
		USER_NAME as string,
		ACTIVITY as string,
		HOLIDAYS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		LOCATION as string,
		BASE_CURRENCY as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		ACC_BOOK_ID as integer,
		EOD_TIME as integer,
		USER_NAME as string,
		ACTIVITY as string,
		HOLIDAYS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LOCATION,
		BASE_CURRENCY,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		VERSION_NUM,
		BOOK_ID,
		BOOK_NAME,
		COMMENTS,
		ACC_BOOK_ID,
		EOD_TIME,
		USER_NAME,
		ACTIVITY,
		HOLIDAYS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
